33:1: And this is the blessing that Moshe, the prophet of God, blessed Bnei Yisroel
33:2: He said: ‘‘Adonoy was revealed from Sinai, and the brilliance of His glory from Seir
appeared to us; He was revealed in His might from Mount Paran
He came with part of the sacred myriads;
The writing of His right hand, from the midst of the fire, He gave the Torah to us.
33:3: all His holy ones of the house of Yisroel — with might He brought them out of Mitzrayim;
and they are led under Your cloud,
33:4: he transmitted it as a heritage to the congregation of Yaakov.
33:5: at the gathering of the counting.
33:6: May Reuvein live to life everlasting, and a second death let him not die,
and his sons will receive their inheritance by their number.
33:7: Now this for Yehudah and he said, [And this is for Yehudah, and he said:]
‘‘Adonoy, accept the prayer of Yehudah when he goes out to wage war,
and return him to his people in peace;
May his hands exact retribution for him from his enemies,
and be a help to him against his enemies.’’
33:8: ‘‘The tumim and the urim You clothed to the man who was found pious before You;
whom You tried with a test, and he was found perfect,
You tested him at the waters of strife, and he was found faithful.
33:9: He who had no mercy on his father and on his mother when they were found guilty by law,
and his sons he did not favor;
for they guarded the charge of Your word
33:10: Worthy are these who shall teach Your law to Yaakov
let them place fragrant incense before You
and totally consumed offerings willingly on Your altar;
33:11: and accept the offering of his hands willingly;
shatter his adversaries at the loins and his enemies, so that they may not arise.’’
33:12: let him live secure with Him;
He will be a shield over him all the day,
and in his land the Shechina will reside.’’
33:13: ‘‘Blessed from before Adonoy is his land, producing delicacies
from the dew of heaven above, and from the flow of springs,
and the deep waters that flow from the depths of the earth below.
33:14: And it produces delicacies and produce from the sun’s harvest;
and it produces delicacies from month to month.
33:15: And from the tops of the early mountains,
and from the sweetness of the perennial hills.
33:16: And from the best of earth and its fullness,
may the One whose Shechina is in heaven, and who was revealed to Moshe in the thornbush, favor him;
let all these come upon Yoseif’s head,
and to the man set apart of his brothers.
33:17: The greatness of his sons is splendor to him, and mighty deeds were done for him from before the Mighty and Exalted One,
with his own might he will kill peoples together to the ends of the earth;
and they are the myriads of the house of Ephraim,
and they are the thousands of the house of Menasheh.’’
33:18: ‘‘Rejoice Zevulun when you go out to wage war against your enemies;
and Yissachar when you go to fix the times of the festivals in Yerushalayim.
33:19: The tribes of Yisroel shall assemble at the mountain of the Beis Hamikdosh —
for the wealth of the nations they shall consume
and treasure hidden in sand will be revealed to them.’’
33:20: and he will kill rulers with kings.
33:21: for there, in his inheritance, Moshe, the great scribe of Yisroel, is buried;
and he went out and came in at the head of the people,
33:22: ‘‘Don is mighty as a cub of lions,
his land drinks from the streams that flow from Masnon.’’
33:23: and he is full of blessing from before Adonoy;
he will inherit the west of the Sea of Ginosar and the south.’’
33:24: he shall be favored by his brothers
and be nourished with the delicacies of kings.’’
33:25: As the days of your youth, so your might.
33:26: There is no god like the God of Yisroel,
Whose Shechina in heaven is in your aid;
and His might is in the heavens of heavens.
33:27: As the dwelling of the eternal God
by Whose word the world was made;
He banished the enemy from your presence and said, ‘Destroy.’
33:28: Yisroel lived securely, alone, like the blessing with which Yaakov their father blessed them
in a land producing grain and wine;
even the skies above them shall serve them with dew.
33:29: You are fortunate, Yisroel, there is none like you — a people whose redemption is from before Adonoy,
and from before Him is the victory of your might;
and your enemies will prevaricate to you,
while you tread on the broken necks of their kings.’’
34:2: and the land of Ephraim and Menasheh;
and all the land of Yehudah up
34:4: Adonoy said to him, ‘‘This is the land that I swore to Avrohom, to Yitzchok, and to Yaakov, saying,
I have shown it to you with your eyes,
but you will not cross over there.’’
34:5: Moshe, Adonoy’s servant, died there, in the land of Moav, by the word of Adonoy.
34:7: And Moshe was 120 years old at his death;
his eyes were not dulled, and the radiance of the glory of his face did not change.
34:10: And there has not ever arisen a prophet within Yisroel like Moshe,
34:12: And for the entire strong hand
in view of all of Yisroel. CHAZAK
